text: Visitors have noted issues with the timed entry system, finding it confusing that entry is only allowed about half an hour before the scheduled time, which can lead to long lines early in the day and empty entry areas later. Crowding is a concern, especially in the early immersive rooms, which some find tight and uncomfortable. Several reviews criticize the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as excessive and out of place. Food service has received negative comments regarding quality and wait times. Accessibility information is reported as difficult to obtain, with phone support not meeting visitor needs.
